purpose: Session identity and test-database assignment for every engineering session observed in this repository. This is a REGISTRY, not a sprint manifest: it records the facts that are knowable from outside a session (its identifier, its database, its PHPUnit config). It deliberately does not declare file ownership for other engineers, because Engineer888 cannot know what they own and guessing is the failure this whole control set exists to prevent.
why_separate_from_sprints: Sprint manifests live in .engineer888/sprints/ and are resolved by OwnershipManifest::active(). Placing other sessions' entries there would make that resolution ambiguous and every ownership lookup would fail closed, breaking the commit path for everyone. The registry is data; the sprints directory is control.
